sources.snippet: This checkpoint is an AutoRound model-free MXFP8 RTN quantization of google/gemma-4-26B-A4B, exported in llm_compressor / compressed-tensors format. Routed experts and the self-attention projections present in the source are stored as F8_E4M3; ...

sources.title: INCModel4/gemma-4-31B-MXFP8-FP8KV-CT-AutoRound · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains a measured MXFP8 compressed-tensors checkpoint of Google's dense Gemma 4 31B model. The transformer Linear weights use 8-bit microscaling with group size 32; the export also includes calibrated static FP8 KV-cache scales.
